entities.name: Sequence query transketolase
observations: 677 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 72.8 kDa and pI 5.79.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt P34736 transketolase, with 100% identity and coverage.
Contains Pfam Transketolase_N, Transket_pyr, and Transketolase_C domains.
Predicted to bind thiamine diphosphate and one divalent metal ion per subunit.

entities.name: P34736 transketolase
observations: Reviewed Scheffersomyces stipitis transketolase; exact sequence match to the query.
Catalyzes reversible two-carbon ketol transfer using thiamine pyrophosphate.
Annotated reaction: sedoheptulose-7-phosphate plus glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate yields ribose-5-phosphate plus xylulose-5-phosphate.
EC 2.2.1.1; binds thiamine diphosphate and Mg2+, with Ca2+, Mn2+, or Co2+ potentially substituting.
Annotated as a homodimer in the cytosol and associated with the pentose-phosphate shunt.

entities.name: Pentose phosphate pathway
observations: The query protein is assigned to the pentose-phosphate shunt through its transketolase activity.
Transketolase transfers two-carbon units between sugar phosphates, linking pentose phosphate intermediates and contributing to carbohydrate degradation and carbon rearrangement.

entities.name: RHEA:10508
observations: D-sedoheptulose 7-phosphate plus D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate reversibly produces D-ribose 5-phosphate plus D-xylulose 5-phosphate.
Reaction is catalyzed by EC 2.2.1.1 transketolase using thiamine diphosphate and a divalent metal ion.
